name: Compute altitude
Refresh AUTOZERO reference
LPS33HW Demo
info:
This flow demonstrates the LPS33HW water-resistant MEMS pressure sensor as an altimeter.

The device config node sets **10 Hz ODR with the ODR/20 low-pass filter enabled** — a fresh pressure sample every 100 ms with the on-chip LPF (~0.5 Hz cutoff) suppressing door-slam and HVAC noise. An inject node fires every second; each tick reads pressure (Pa) and temperature (°C). A function node converts the pressure to relative altitude using the barometric formula `44330 * (1 - (p / 101325)^(1/5.255))`.

Because atmospheric pressure drifts with the weather (~1 hPa per ~8 m of equivalent altitude), the AUTOZERO reference is refreshed every 10 s via a second inject + function node pair. This makes the altitude chart a true *relative* measurement — climb one floor (~3 m) and watch the trace shift, then return.

Adjust the I²C bus, address (0x5C for SA0=GND, 0x5D for SA0=VDD), ODR, and LPF bandwidth in the device config node. Drop ODR to 1 Hz and disable the LPF for battery-powered weather monitoring instead of altimetry.
